summary: Iteration 10 batch verification — All 17 backend pytest tests PASS and all 6 frontend UI checks PASS. Coverage: (1) /api/auth/check-username reserved 'admin'→false, 'ab'→false (too short), unique username→available:true. (2) /api/auth/register: username collision→400 'Username already taken'; same email w/o username→400; same email + DIFFERENT username→200 with user.email == ORIGINAL public email and user.username == new handle (email +reN suffix hidden by public_email surface). (3) /api/auth/login accepts email, phone, and username identifiers. (4) /api/mlm/leaderboard returns 8-10 entries dominated by fake Indian roster (30 pool → 8 selected by ISO-week deterministic hash) with ₹ 12–20 lakh top-rank earnings, stable across refresh. (5) Admin /api/admin/payment-config GET returns doc with cashfree_secret_masked (masked ***EFG); POST saves; empty secret_key does NOT clobber existing value (verified via mask persistence); non-admin token → 403. (6) /api/site/payment-provider returns provider/cashfree_active/cashfree_env public shape. (7) /api/site/purchase-kit-content returns default with hero_title/subtitle/image + 8 features + 4 how_it_works; POST /admin/purchase-kit-content saves and reflects on subsequent GET. Frontend: tab title = 'EverGro eMart · 8-Level Income Plan · ₹7,200 Purchasing Kit' (no 'Emergent'). navbar-register-link href='/join-now'. /join-now shows join-stepper, join-phone-input, join-send-otp-btn. /purchase-kit shows purchase-kit-page, pk-hero-title/subtitle/image, pk-cta-btn, pk-features-section with pk-feature-0..7, pk-how-section with pk-step-1..4, pk-bottom-cta, pk-bottom-cta-btn. /register live username status renders icon SVG for both 'admin' (X) and unique (Check). /admin/payments admin-payments-page shows cf-app-id-input, cf-secret-input, cf-env-sandbox, cf-env-prod, cf-active-toggle, pg-save-btn — Save triggered success toast 'Payment config saved. Changes are live immediately.'
critical_code_review_comments: check-username reserved list is small (7 items); consider expanding to include common attack/impersonation handles (support, official, verified, admin1, root1, etc.) and adding rate-limiting to prevent enumeration.

leaderboard mixes real users with fakes and sorts by earnings; if a real user has more earnings than the fake top-1 range (₹20 lakh), fake entries get pushed down but rank labels are not re-computed — currently OK since UI uses index, but be aware.
/site/payment-provider exposes cashfree_app_id publicly when active; App ID is generally not a secret, but confirm this matches Cashfree security guidance.
server.py has grown to 2178 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, mlm, payments, admin, site) for maintainability.

Register.jsx submit disable condition uses `form.username && usernameStatus.available === false` — if username is empty and required by /join-now flow, the register-only path still allows empty username; that is intentional (register keeps username optional) but worth documenting.
test_credentials: admin@evergroemart.com / Admin@123 used successfully. New test users created with TEST_iter10_<timestamp>@example.com prefix for cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test users (unique email/phone/username each) via /auth/register during test — prefixed TEST_iter10 for identification. Admin payment-config was set to cashfree provider with UI_TEST creds; main agent may want to reset to easebuzz default if needed for other users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 introduced: username-based signup (Instagram-style live availability at /api/auth/check-username), /join-now 3-step OTP-first flow, /purchase-kit rich admin-editable landing, /admin/payments Cashfree/Easebuzz config with hot-swap, deterministic weekly fake Indian leaderboard, tab title cleanup. All 17 backend tests + 6 frontend checks GREEN. Firebase falls back to dev OTP on preview domain; /join-now displays join-dev-otp banner (only after send-OTP).
